description: This file defines the ApiTokenHelper class, providing static methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users, primarily used for testing API security and authorization.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Helper class with static methods to create JWT tokens for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an administrator user with admin roles.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no specific roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token based on the provided username and roles, setting token expiration to 1 hour.
